analysis.title: Commodity Compass: Tether and the Rise of Digital Gold: When New Money Meets Ancient Gold
key_insights: The 15 largest gold-backed crypto tokens have a combined market cap above US$6bn, about 45 tonnes of implied gold. Aggregate trading volume passed US$150bn year-to-date in 2026, above the full-year 2025 record.

Tokenized gold is small against the traditional market. Global gold trades about 3,000 tonnes a day (about 950 spot, 2,000 derivatives, 50 ETFs) against about 3 tonnes a day in gold tokens. The tokenized universe is about 1% of the roughly 4,000 tonnes held by physically backed gold ETFs.
SG says the token volume should not be added to global gold liquidity, because the underlying exposure is likely hedged in the OTC and spot markets.

Digital gold growth is attributed to fractional ownership, 24/7 trading, instant settlement and, for some providers, yield from lending the backing bullion. CME launched 1-Ounce Gold futures in January 2025 and extended trading to 24/7 in July 2026.
Turnover in digital gold is far higher than in traditional vehicles. SG says this implies shorter holding periods and a more tactical investor base, likely amplifying outflows during corrections.

SG estimates Tether held about 146.5 tonnes of gold as of June 2026, 33rd globally among central-bank-equivalent holders (near Libya, about 13 tonnes above the Philippines). As a gold ETF it would rank 7th, about 25 tonnes short of 6th.

SG calls Tether a hybrid between a central bank and a gold ETF. Part of its gold backs its stablecoin liabilities and part backs the XAUT token. Gold is about 10% of a balance sheet of about USD 185bn.

Tether's next quarterly reserves attestation is scheduled for 31 October 2026, the first update on gold since June. SG's model forecasts about 161 tonnes at 30 September, which would keep Tether 7th among gold ETF-equivalents. About 11 tonnes (7%) more would move it to 6th.
SG estimates Tether Group is the 40th largest gold holder globally when the central bank and ETF rankings are combined.

Since early 2023, Tether's gold holdings grew about 31% a year against 13.6% for gold ETF holdings and 1.8% for central bank reserves. Tether added 87.5 tonnes, 5th in cumulative net purchases since 2023 behind 1 ETF and 3 central banks.

SG estimates about 65% of Tether's gold inflows are new money from people who did not own gold before, using WGC survey data as a proxy. That implies about 70 tonnes of new demand from the 110 tonnes added between June 2022 and June 2026.
On 29 September Tether minted about 119,700 XAUT, nearly US$500mn of gold-linked exposure, initially sent to treasury inventory and not into circulation.

The World Gold Council's base case is US$160-170bn of digital gold by 2031 (about 1,235 tonnes at US$4,150/oz, up from about 375 tonnes), against a US$45-55bn market today. SG treats the WGC's US$700bn upper bound (about 5,250 tonnes) as an advocacy ceiling, not a forecast. Reaching it would need at least an eightfold increase in holdings.

sector_views.rationale: Digital gold is growing fast but remains niche at about 1% of physical gold ETF holdings. SG sees Tether as a significant and growing source of new gold demand.

macro_indicators.interpretation: SG model nowcast ahead of the 31 October attestation. It would keep Tether 7th among gold ETF-equivalent holders.
From Tether's June attestation, ranking it 33rd among central-bank-equivalent holders.
The price SG uses to convert WGC digital gold dollar scenarios into tonnes.

crypto_views: The 15 largest gold-backed tokens (XAUT, PAXG and others) hold more than US$6bn of market cap and about 45 tonnes of implied gold. XAUT is about US$3.25bn and PAXG about US$1.8bn.
Tether is the largest holder behind a gold token. Its XAUT supply rose by about 119,700 tokens (nearly US$500mn) on 29 September.
Some tokens pay yield from lending the backing bullion, which attracted interest while nominal yields are elevated.
Vaulted digital gold providers include BullionVault (US$5bn+) and GoldMoney (US$4bn+).
risk_factors: Digital gold demand is more volatile and price-sensitive than central bank or ETF demand, and may amplify outflows during corrections.
SG's Tether holdings figures after June are model estimates, not attested numbers, and the 31 October attestation may differ.
The WGC's US$700bn digital gold scenario is built on investor surveys and comes from an industry body that promotes gold ownership.

tension_points.bull_case: Digital gold is growing faster than traditional channels. About 65% of Tether's inflows are estimated to be new money, and the WGC base case sees US$160-170bn by 2031.
tension_points.bear_case: Token holders trade tactically with high turnover and may amplify outflows in corrections. The sector is about 1% of gold ETF holdings, and the WGC's US$700bn figure is advocacy.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Tether's 31 October attestation showing holdings well below the SG forecast of about 161 tonnes.
